clips.prompt_video:
Podcast-style video. Static camera, medium close-up framing locked to the start frame throughout. She speaks directly to someone off-camera, delivering her two lines with one short, completely silent pause between them.

No captions. No background music. No camera movement or angle changes.

She says each line exactly as written, only once, without repeating, adding or changing any word, and without "um", "uh", "eh", "mhm", "mm" or any hum or agreement sound that is not in the script. Only her voice is heard: nobody else speaks, hums or answers at any moment. After her last line she says nothing else and makes no sound: she stays silent with her lips closed until the clip ends.

SCRIPT:

Línea 1: "Les juro que yo no me podía ni poner un jean, porque atrás me quedaba nada. Plana, plana."
Delivery: she only says her own lines, never the other person's questions or comments; she says the whole line in one continuous flow, going straight from "nada" into "Plana, plana" with no gap and no sound in between; funny frustration, she gestures down toward her hips with both hands and on "Plana, plana" shakes her head with a resigned little smile; natural hands, eyebrows and head, nothing stiff

Línea 2: "Imagínate que ya estaba ahorrando pa' operarme."
Delivery: she rolls her eyes silently first, lips closed, with no sigh and no hum, then says it half embarrassed, like confessing it to a friend; right after "operarme" she closes her lips and stays quiet

Audio: she speaks in a natural Colombian Spanish accent (not neutral, not Mexican, not from Spain) at a quick, animated conversational pace, with the bright, slightly higher-pitched voice of a woman in her late 20s, confessional and self-deprecating, laughing at herself. The voice sounds like it's coming from a close podcast mic with little echo and reverberation. As her mouth moves away from the microphone, the audio changes in volume. No other voice, no "mhm", no hums. Soft room tone of a small podcast studio, close-mic'd podcast sound.

clips.prompt_video: Duración: 5s. Video vertical 9:16 a partir de la imagen. Cámara fija, sin zoom ni acercamiento. Ella se queda de lado, igual que en la imagen, termina de acomodarse el jean en la cintura con la misma mano, se mira de lado en el espejo, deja caer los hombros y suelta un suspiro por la nariz con la boca cerrada. Su cuerpo no cambia de forma: el jean sigue flojo, recto y plano atrás todo el clip. Nunca queda de espaldas a la cámara. La luz no cambia. Nadie habla: no hay voces ni bocas que se muevan. Sin cortes ni cambios de plano, sin texto, sin subtítulos, sin logos agregados. She stays in the same side-on pose as the start frame the whole shot: she never turns to face forward and never puts both hands on her hips. Her lips stay closed from the first frame to the last. The blurred figure at the left edge of the frame stays exactly where it is, small, out of focus and almost still: it never moves into the frame, never grows, and its grey t-shirt stays plain, with no letters, drawings or prints anywhere. Only one small, slow movement; nothing appears or disappears.
